product_one_liner.value: Lumilens designs and manufactures optical interconnects that help hyperscalers scale AI data centers with higher bandwidth and lower power consumption.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes scale-up and scale-out optical interconnects for hyperscaler AI data centers, emphasizing bandwidth density and lower power consumption: https://lumilens.com/news-insights/lumilens-emerges-with-900m-in-funding.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer have no pricing link, and the conventional pricing endpoint yielded no pricing page. Homepage: https://lumilens.com/.

named_customers.notes: A readable customer-profile section contains only one named-customer record, below the required minimum of two. The empty list follows the specified fewer-than-two rule and does not imply that Lumilens has no customers: https://akta.pro/company-profiles/0000du6/lumilens.

employee_band.notes: The company-declared LinkedIn size is explicitly 201–500 employees. This self-reported range is used rather than the smaller count of linked employee profiles; an undated external headcount differs: https://linkedin.com/company/102735195.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly lists its headquarters as San Jose, California: https://linkedin.com/company/102735195. | hq_country: The company identifies San Jose as its headquarters and lists its address in the US: https://linkedin.com/company/102735195.

founded_year.notes: The company's LinkedIn page explicitly states “Founded 2024”: https://linkedin.com/company/102735195.

eng_blog.notes: The news index contains one company blog post, “Networks Are Now the AI Bottleneck,” alongside a press release and media coverage. It does not meet the requirement for at least two engineering-authored build posts: https://lumilens.com/news-insights.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link. Checks of the conventional docs/help subdomains also yielded no public documentation. Homepage: https://lumilens.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists 163 positions, with no titles matching the qualifying AI, ML or data-science categories. Data-engineering roles were excluded as instructed: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lumilens?hl=en-US.

model_provider.notes: No publicly disclosed AI model/provider was established after checking the blog, manufacturing material and privacy disclosures. LumiCore is described as a photonic/electronic platform, not an AI model; the privacy policy makes its service-provider list available only on request. Sources: https://lumilens.com/news-insights/networks-are-now-the-ai-bottleneck, https://lumilens.com/next-gen-manufacturing-robotics-ai and https://lumilens.com/privacy.

compliance_certs.notes: The readable legal page names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS, supporting an empty list rather than an unknown: https://lumilens.com/terms-of-use.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest August 2026 round is identified as Series C: https://dealroom.co/news/143558-lumilens-raises-700m-series-c-to-swap-data-center-wires-for-light. | funding_date: The latest funding announcement is dated August 6, 2026, yielding 2026-08: https://lumilens.com/news-insights/lumilens-emerges-with-900m-in-funding. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile records the latest Series C at $700,000,000. This is the reported rounded figure: the company's announcement says “more than $700 million” in new funding, distinct from over $900 million cumulatively raised. Source: https://lumilens.com/news-insights/lumilens-emerges-with-900m-in-funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced more than $700 million in new funding on August 6, 2026, inside the requested 18-month window: https://lumilens.com/news-insights/lumilens-emerges-with-900m-in-funding.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The complete live board contains no qualifying SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive titles: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lumilens?hl=en-US.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 emergence announcement introduced Lumilens publicly and announced that its first product was commercially shipping into production AI data centers. This falls within the six-month window, although the first shipment's exact date is not disclosed: https://lumilens.com/news-insights/lumilens-emerges-with-900m-in-funding.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Neera Patel's profile lists a Lumilens Chief Financial Officer start date of October 2026, inside the requested 12-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/neera-patel-6097505.
